title: Hells Angels member hospitalized for weeks after the visit

tellings.quote: and he had checked himself into the hospital for weeks

plain: Brandon Fugal, the owner of Skinwalker Ranch, a property known for reports of strange events, says a man named Eric Bard, a member of the Hells Angels motorcycle club, visited the ranch at some point in the last decade. According to Fugal, Bard later checked himself into a hospital, away from the ranch, and stayed for weeks. Fugal tells it as an example of the ranch's effects reaching people even after they leave.
